title: Controlled-Substance Handover and the Late-Delivery Refund on Delivery & Pickup Services Orders
content:
The handover share of a late-delivery refund on a Delivery & Pickup Services order depends on the late order's speed and contents, as its order record shows them. The late-delivery refund is multiplied by the handover share, taken as a percentage, acting on the refund as worked out up to that point; no rounding takes place at this step.

## Rule

| Late order's speed | Carries a controlled-substance prescription | Handover share |
|---|---|---|
| one-hour express | yes | 90 percent |
| same-day | yes | 95 percent |
| one-hour express | no | 100 percent |
| same-day | no | 100 percent |

Any other order keeps the handover share at 100 percent.

## Hypothetical cases

- A late express order carrying a Schedule II controlled prescription, refund worked out so far at 5.592: multiplied by 90 percent, 5.0328.
- A late same-day order carrying a Schedule V controlled prescription, refund so far 7.99: multiplied by 95 percent, 7.5905.
- A late express order carrying only maintenance prescriptions and store items: 100 percent, the refund unchanged.
